purpose: Characterize transfer of e_h=0.5*dt*(hdot_np1-hdot_n) to real nonlinear B1.10 hydraulics without treating any finite backward-Euler refinement endpoint as exact truth.

matrix.finite_reference_endpoint: N512 only as a finite comparison endpoint

observer_construction.hdot_n: Gate-B source-bound right-sided semi-discrete bootstrap under the new prescribed bottom head

finite_comparators.ratio_R512: EOBS/E1_512 when E1_512 is finite and positive
finite_comparators.important_semantics: E1_512 is not called true error; D256_512 is not a proof that N512 is converged.

predeclared_interpretation.if_EOBS_lt_E1_512: negative transfer evidence: the observer does not even dominate the finite N512 endpoint difference for that case
predeclared_interpretation.if_EOBS_ge_E1_512: finite-reference-consistent conservative relation observed for that case, but no true-error upper bound is qualified
predeclared_interpretation.if_all_cases_EOBS_ge_E1_512: supports taking the candidate to a later independent qualification design, but does not select a multiplier, threshold or normalization
predeclared_interpretation.if_ratios_are_state_dependent: retain explicit state/envelope dependence; do not fit a universal factor in C2
predeclared_interpretation.machine_floor_cases: report separately; never strengthen the reference claim because a tail difference is small

pass_rules_for_characterization_harness: All 15 cases complete N1 through N512 under frozen controls or any failure is preserved and attributed without changing the matrix.
Every completed substep passes the unchanged 1e-12 external hard mass gate.
Bootstrap capacity and conductivity are finite and positive in the admitted unsaturated matrix.
EOBS, E1_512, D128_256 and D256_512 are finite nonnegative observables.
O0 and O2 machine-readable outputs are identical for every completed case.
Production Richards/runtime source remains identical to the F-VQ29 base.
not_a_pass_rule: a universal defect-to-error factor must exist
N512 must be floor-resolved or exact
next_if_characterization_supports_transf: Define a separate owner candidate profile and then open independent held-out F-VQ qualification. Do not use the C2 calibration matrix itself as held-out evidence.
